title: IRL Date Energy Table
oneLiner: A playful singles-event tool that replaces swipe fatigue with low-pressure table prompts, exit signals, and friend-safe follow-ups.
label: Fun / Portfolio
targetUser: Dating-app-fatigued singles, friend groups, singles-event hosts, matchmakers, bars, cafes, and community organizers.
keyUX: Build an event table plan, set low-pressure prompt cards, mark energy/boundaries, collect opt-in follow-ups, and generate a friend-safe post-event recap.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive playful web app prototype called "IRL Date Energy Table" for dating-app-fatigued singles, friend groups, singles-event hosts, matchmakers, bars, cafes, and community organizers. The app should help an event host build a table rotation plan, set low-pressure prompt cards, mark energy and boundaries, collect mutual opt-in follow-ups, and generate a friend-safe post-event recap. Required sections: event energy header, swipe fatigue intake, table rotation board, prompt card deck, boundary and exit-signal controls, mutual opt-in follow-up lane, friend wingperson notes, and shareable post-event recap card. Use realistic sample data for a Friday cafe mixer with 24 attendees, two friend groups, tired app users, and opt-in-only follow-up rules. Design direction: use the playful-experimental profile with bold but readable social-game energy, expressive status stickers, lively contrast accents, and a polished portfolio-worthy first screen that feels fun rather than desperate. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working event tool.
